definition.boundary: Optional CLI discovery only. Full Playwright/axe/browser availability must be established by the recipe in the consumer project; local Node dependencies may provide it without a global command.
Match framework/version; no forced Next or Vercel hosting.
definition.description: Read targeted Vercel React rules when the actual project uses React.

definition.boundary: Advisory audit; no silent fetch or pin changes.
definition.description: Audit web interaction with Vercel guidance and WCAG.

definition.boundary: No binaries/hooks; one primary procedure; brand and project authority override tastes.
definition.description: Use Impeccable instruction-only design procedure for frontend work.

definition.boundary: Read-only discovery; mutation needs task authority.
Project runtime version must be checked at use.
Python 3.10+ and requirements.txt; no installer side effects.

checks.recipe: Use the repository validation commands; inspect the actual diff; preserve unrelated work.
Verify claim/source references, freshness, producer mode and exact-byte interchange integrity.
Build/serve distributed output; inspect desktop/mobile screenshots and interactions; run Playwright and axe; review asset budget and reduced motion.
Detect React/framework versions; use relevant pinned rules; build and verify browser/hydration behavior.
Run actual project type/schema/route tests; isolate database migrations; test failure and scope invariants.
Test clean checkout and distributed artifacts; review README promises/compatibility; verify remote SHA/CI then immutable tag/release destination.

D-001.rationale: Use the cross-agent repository instruction convention as the small routing entry point.
D-001.revisit_when: Provider discovery semantics materially change or a better interoperable convention wins.
D-001.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
validation: Source review and bounded consumer tests before release.

D-002.rationale: Use skills for on-demand procedures and references rather than expanding always-loaded instructions.
D-002.revisit_when: A target agent cannot consume the format or measured discovery/activation fails.
D-002.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
validation: Source review and bounded consumer tests before release.

D-003.rationale: Keep durable human/LLM-readable behavioral guidance diffable and provider-neutral.
D-003.revisit_when: A machine-readable contract is needed instead of natural-language guidance.
D-003.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
validation: Source review and bounded consumer tests before release.

D-004.rationale: Compose references to context, skills, capabilities and checks without inventing an executable DSL.
D-004.revisit_when: Repeated real consumers require semantics YAML cannot express safely and clearly.
D-004.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
validation: Source review and bounded consumer tests before release.

alternatives: Admit a pinned real peer checkpoint as advisory evidence
D-005.rationale: The real agent-assisted Signals checkpoint passed exact-byte and semantic admission. Advice maps to Context decisions; source references, adoption, materialization and actual use remain separate.
D-005.revisit_when: Producer schema/privacy/provenance changes or claim support fails a targeted review.
D-005.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
D-005.selection: Signals evidence -> Context decision -> project lock -> use receipt
unknowns: No configured model-led runtime or independent comparative tool benefit was established.
validation: Actual producer 4ab32a1d7ae09ae0ebb6102b4b2d7571291c5c97 -> Context read-only consumer; 10 candidates mapped with activation false.

D-006.rationale: Context AI equips existing agents; it should not duplicate orchestration/execution runtimes.
D-006.revisit_when: Multiple real consumers demonstrate a missing capability that cannot live in an existing runtime.
D-006.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
D-006.selection: no general agent runtime in context-ai
validation: Source review and bounded consumer tests before release.

D-007.rationale: Current upstream launcher includes downloads and hook effects. Keep its web documentation procedure, exclude execution and use direct reads; actual browser trial required before broad endorsement.
D-007.revisit_when: Compatibility, hooks, maintenance cost, or real-task output is worse than simpler alternatives.
D-007.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
unknowns: Binary/hook behavior is not exercised or endorsed.
validation: Source/notice review and the v1 representative browser exercise.

D-008.rationale: Strong concise design guidance and a useful upstream source for visual design behavior.
D-008.revisit_when: The upstream skill changes materially or a more suitable general reference is demonstrated.
D-008.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
validation: Source review and bounded consumer tests before release.

D-009.rationale: Use targeted React/web review guidance rather than impose a framework migration.
D-009.revisit_when: Consumer stack differs or guidance conflicts with measured project needs.
D-009.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
validation: Source review and bounded consumer tests before release.

D-010.rationale: Combine deterministic browser/a11y checks with actual visual inspection; neither alone proves UX quality.
D-010.revisit_when: Consumer environment cannot support the tools or a stronger compatible mechanism is measured.
D-010.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
validation: Source review and bounded consumer tests before release.

D-012.rationale: Keep decisions evidence-backed without requiring unrealistic popularity or corroboration thresholds for low-risk trials.
D-012.revisit_when: Domain-specific evidence requires a different hierarchy.
D-012.rollback: Undo unchanged owned materialization; retain old pins.
D-012.selection: authoritative specs -> first-party docs/repos -> maintained adopted OSS -> strong engineering publications -> project synthesis
validation: Source review and bounded consumer tests before release.
